posts.title: email
posts.description: Academics seem to genuinely exist in a dialectically interesting relationship to emails: they really do seem to love and hate email. In the 2010s it was not unusual to see boasts about things like inbox zero, the flawed in my opinion idea that “reading” all the emails in one’s inbox is somehow a good idea and that a zero is some indication of “nothing left to do here” with respect to communicating
